episode_summary: In this episode, mindset coach Paul Salter discusses the critical role of structure in achieving success in real estate. He emphasizes how structure removes emotional interference in decision-making, conserves energy, and builds emotional stability. Salter provides actionable tactics like 'Plan Tomorrow Today' to help agents implement structure and enhance their productivity.
